nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 closed the CRITICAL/WARNING at scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts:214: the allowlist staleness check (findStaleAllowlistEntries) previously only asserted the entry's `path` existed in the scanned file set, while scanForTmpdirRoots filtered allowlisted paths OUT of the scan before running the detection regexes -- so the scan never learned whether the entry was actually suppressing a real finding. If the allowlisted file (test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts) were later migrated onto createTestTmpdir, or its rooting line simply deleted, the entry would have kept matching the still-existing path and stayed green forever, permanently exempting that whole file from the gate with no signal. Fix: scanForTmpdirRoots now scans EVERY file unconditionally (files.flatMap(scanFileForRoots), allowlisted or not), tallies a per-allowlisted-path suppression count from findings that land on an allowlisted path, and findStaleAllowlistEntries's predicate is now '!knownPaths.has(entry.path) || suppressionCounts.get(entry.path) === 0' (was just the first clause). Only findings whose path is NOT allowlisted are still surfaced in the final report (rootFindings = allFindings.filter(path not allowlisted)) -- a live-suppressing entry behaves exactly as before, a suppressing-nothing entry now itself fails the gate as a stale-allowlist-entry finding. Pinned with 2 new tests next to the existing synthetic-entry pair at test/check-test-tmpdir.test.ts: 'an entry matching an existing file that suppressed zero findings is stale (US-R2-002)' and 'an allowlisted file IS scanned (not skipped up front): a second, non-allowlisted file with the same finding still fires (US-R2-002)'. Verified the real ALLOWLIST entry (test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts, line 43's mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), ...))) still produces exactly one live suppression under the new logic, so `bun scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts` over the real tree stays green (check:test-tmpdir: ok). Quality gates: bun run typecheck clean; bun test 6071 pass / 0 fail; bun run check:all fully green (file-size, coverage, debt-markers, dead-code, dup, lint, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, test-tmpdir, skip-ratchet) -- no ratchet/_ref edits needed, this story's diff (+66/-9 across 3 files) did not trip any budget. Did not touch .claude/commands/direct-fix.md (US-R2-003's separate doc-drift WARNING, still queued).
